name: Distal Femur Fracture
definition: Fracture of the distal femur, often intra-articular, occurring after high-energy trauma or fragility injury in older adults.

investigations.principle: Radiographs are first-line; CT defines intra-articular extension and surgical anatomy.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, infection, tumor or occult-injury assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Most displaced fractures require fixation; fragility and periprosthetic patterns need individualized planning.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Janu/Uru-bhagna principles may complement recovery after fixation.

patientEducation.summary: Fracture of the distal femur, often intra-articular, occurring after high-energy trauma or fragility injury in older adults.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe vascular symptoms, major trauma, suspected infection, pathological fracture, neurovascular compromise or other listed red flags.
